resources.string: When on, Sotreus broadcasts rotating anonymous tokens that only approved friends can recognise.
This transmits. It is separate from passive observation and needs Bluetooth advertise permission. No account, wallet or device ID is ever broadcast.
Add a friend first. Presence only broadcasts tokens for approved friends.
This deletes %1$s and your shared presence secret from this phone. They will no longer be recognised nearby.
Friendship is always approved by both people — never inferred from being nearby. Your friend list is never published.
No friends yet. Show your QR to a friend and scan theirs.
Ask your friend to scan this in Sotreus, then scan theirs. Both of you approve by scanning.
This code holds your display name and an app-generated presence key. No account, wallet, email or device ID.
QR code for adding %1$s as a friend in Sotreus
Set a display name in Settings › Profile so friends know who you are.
%1$s added. Ask them to scan your QR too.
That is not a Sotreus friend code.
Add me as a friend in Sotreus: %1$s
You opened a Sotreus invite. Adding them lets your phone recognise their presence tokens. They still need to add you.
